title: Finding
description: A high-level conclusion synthesised from ASSESSED claims. Findings must not introduce facts that are not present in the referenced claims — a finding is a synthesis, not a new assertion path. A finding's confidence cannot exceed the confidence of the weakest claim assessment it depends on for a load-bearing element. Validation of this invariant is planned; until then it is enforced by review.

id.description: Stable entity identifier in format boe:finding:<ulid>. Constant across versions.

title.description: A short descriptive title for the finding.

statement.description: The finding stated precisely. Findings may be more interpretive than claims but must still be grounded in the evidence.

claim_ids.description: Claims that this finding synthesises. At least one required.

rationale.description: Why the underlying claims, taken together, support this finding at the stated confidence level.

caveats.description: Important limitations, gaps, or conditions on this finding.
